license_note: No LICENSE file in the repo; src/module.json declares "license": "MIT" and the author asked for it to be included.
demo_content: 23 bundled breaks (samples/*.wav, ~16 MB) staged in the module's samples/; breakbeat's own ensure_portal_exists() symlinks /data/UserData/breakbeat-samples/Built-in to them at load. The module dir is over HEAVY_MB, so it ships in extra.data.
upstream_build: scripts/build.sh: gcc -Ofast -DNDEBUG -shared -fPIC -Isrc/dsp src/dsp/*.c -lpthread; dist/breakbeat/{dsp.so,module.json,ui.js,status_view.js,slice_editor.js,presets/,samples/*.wav}; install.sh symlinks /data/UserData/breakbeat-samples/Built-in -> module samples
